propositions: CodeHealthConfig.enabled field is declared in the schema but never read anywhere in src/rebar, rendering it inert despite being settable and documented.

Structural metrics (module_size_distribution, oversized_module_count, complexity_summary, duplication_summary) evaluate unconditionally regardless of the enabled flag's value, violating the advertised default-false behavior.

The inert-config detection gate at commit 6754 cannot catch this field because it matches bare attribute names globally and .enabled is read on other configs (ui.enabled, LangfuseConfig), causing a false negative.
Operator ruling on 2026-08-05 decided to DELETE the field rather than wire it, removing the only advertised off-switch for code-health analysis.

Removal required addition of warn-class tombstones for both cfg key (code_health.enabled) and env var (REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ENABLED) to prevent silent drops and maintain config-surface golden-file integrity.
